title: Unilever is elevating its R&D hair care game in 2026. Here’s how…
summary: Port Sunlight, Unilever’s key hub for science and R&D, is making strides in the hair care innovation space. Jason Harcup, Chief R&D Officer, Beauty and Wellbeing Division at Unilever, explains how the conglomerate is advancing the hair care goalpost
